features.title: Every Financial Tool You Need

items.title: Smart GST Invoicing
items.text: Generate GST-compliant tax invoices with e-Way Bill, HSN codes, and automated GSTR returns.

items.title: Financial Intelligence
items.text: Real-time P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow dashboards. Multi-currency forex, live inventory valuation.

items.title: Bank Reconciliation
items.text: One-click auto-reconciliation against imported bank statements. Auto-match payments and deposits.

items.title: Automated Workflows
items.text: Invoice aging alerts, payment reminders, and approval workflows reduce manual follow-ups by 90%.

items.title: Multi-Entity Support
items.text: Manage multiple companies, branches, and cost centers from a single unified dashboard.

items.title: Compliance Vault
items.text: Store and manage all statutory documents, GST filings, TDS certificates, and audit trail records securely.

items.title: Time & Billing
items.text: Track billable hours by project, auto-generate invoices from timesheets, and manage project profitability.

items.title: Payroll Engine
items.text: Process payroll with PF/ESI/TDS deductions, generate payslips, and file returns automatically.

items.title: Inventory & Catalog
items.text: Real-time stock tracking with FIFO/LIFO/Weighted Average costing, reorder alerts, and batch/serial control.

items.question: How does Rooman Books ensure real-time speed and accuracy?
items.answer: Rooman Books uses an asynchronous financial engine with in-memory caching and real-time ledger synchronization.

items.question: Are all modules in the sidebar fully unlocked?
items.answer: Yes! All locks have been removed. Every module is 100% active and functional.

items.question: How does user access and authentication work?
items.answer: Click "Access Rooman Books" to go directly to the sign-in page. Sign in with your credentials or create a new organization account.

items.question: How is my financial data protected?
items.answer: Your financial transactions are encrypted with 256-bit bank-grade security and backed up continuously.
